why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the free game Go to Mars Rally Championship and press Start your first stage, or open the game directly. It runs in a desktop or mobile browser with keyboard, touch or gamepad, and needs no download or signup. The 41-second trailer above shows real leaderboard runs and an online race.

2 Step 2 : Claim your pilot Playing needs no account, but the pilot page lets you sign in with X so your call sign becomes your @handle with a check mark on every board. You can also link a Solana wallet from Phantom, Solflare or Backpack, which claims existing runs and backs up the profile.

5 Step 5 : Try the reversed boards Every stage also has a Reversed board, which runs the stage finish to start through the same gates, with its own standings such as the Stage 2 reversed board . Choose Reversed after picking a stage and compare your time with the pilots listed there.

6 Step 6 : Take on the storm boards The Storm board runs the stage in a full dust storm: crosswinds and gusts push the rover, the grip is dust-slicked, the same storm hits every pilot, and the battery drains faster. Choose Storm after picking a stage, and read the Stage 2 storm standings for the times to chase.

7 Step 7 : Combine both with Reversed storm The fourth board per stage, Reversed storm, runs finish to start in storm winds, and the Stage 2 reversed storm board lists its standings. Choose it once the other boards feel familiar. Every board time is re-simulated from the pilot's inputs before it is posted.

9 Step 9 : Keep driving and follow along Run the daily challenge , a seeded stage that is the same for every pilot, and use ghost racing to line up against a board run and study its braking points. Follow @marsrallychamp on X for updates.
